grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 44721 while invoice_id has only 2330 distinct values and stock_code 3141, so neither column alone is unique (no column's distinct_count equals row_count) and a single invoice spans many product lines; duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, meaning every row is already a distinct combination of its columns, so a deterministic derived identity over invoice_id and stock_code uniquely identifies each invoice line without any aggregation needed, confirming grain_type transaction with one row per invoice line item.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document number such as 489434-489443 with null_rate 0.0, identifying which invoice a line belongs to and forming part of the line identity.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag with two distinct values (true/false) and null_rate 0.0 marking whether the line represents a cancelled transaction, a classification label rather than a measure.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock keeping code such as 10002, 10080, 10123C with 3141 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, identifying the product on the line and forming part of the line identity.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product name such as '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND' with null_rate 0.005098, nullable because some stock codes lack a recorded description in source data.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Signed unit count per line ranging from -1395 to 5184 with null_rate 0.0, a measure summed or compared across lines, with negative values corresponding to cancellation lines.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice line such as 2009-12-01T07:45:00 with null_rate 0.0; samples always show :00 seconds, so the finest resolved grain is minute.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Per-unit price ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0, a measure aggregated or multiplied with quantity for line value.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier ranging 12346-18287 with null_rate 0.300664, nullable because many invoice lines (about 30%) were recorded without an associated customer; an identifier stored as a number so it labels rather than measures.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country such as Australia, Austria, Belgium among 24 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, describing the geography of the invoice line.

category_description: Each row represents one invoice line item: a specific product on a specific invoice, with its quantity, unit price, cancellation flag, timestamp, and customer/country context.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, stating the time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that consumes this contract to emit gold models.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and linted before a human reviewer approves it; only after approval does the modeling engine read the contract to generate the gold fact and its dimensions.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or reinterpret cancellation lines (is_cancellation flag and negative quantity values remain as-is), does not resolve the ~30% missing customer_id values, and does not dedupe beyond the declared invoice_id plus stock_code identity; such decisions are left to downstream consumers and review.
